title: Console: a console-created (package-less) app's routes and an out-of-bundle page route still read whole /meta/object, /meta/view and /meta/page lists
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a (perf observation), from #29235 (PR #29413; report comment 6579566736, `/mnt/project-files/issue-29235/os-dev-report.json`) · filed by `domain:ui#3` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** An admin who builds an app in the Console (no package behind it, the common shape for a tenant's own and AI-generated apps) pays for whole metadata lists on routes that name one item. #28645, #29121 and #29235 removed these list reads for packaged apps and for Home; a console-created app and a page outside the app bundle still download them, which is the heaviest first open a tenant sees (the object registry is 551 KB raw on app-crm).

**Observed (the #29235 os-dev, CDP `Network.requestWillBeSent` initiator stacks on a production Console, `objectstack dev --fresh`, app-crm plus a runtime app `ops_app`).**

1. Inside a package-less app, `useNavMemberGates` reads its names-only scope with views, which reads the whole `/meta/view` list (7,014 B on app-crm), on every route of that app. Outside an app #29121 already passes `views: false`.
2. A package-less app's object routes read the whole object registry from `AppContent`: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts` documents that "an app item without a package id has no package to scope by", so the route falls back to the registry instead of reading the route's object (and its lookup targets) by name.
3. A page route for a page the app bundle does not hold reads the whole `/meta/page` list (AppContent's page scope, prefer-local) instead of the one page by name.

These are read-only inferences from the measured initiators, not re-measured by the seat.

**Wanted.** On these three routes, read the named item(s) by name (`readObjectsByName`, the by-name `getItem` read, or `useReadItemsByName` from PR #29413) while nothing else has loaded the list, and use the list once something has. Record overlays that need the whole registry for related lists keep it, as `appObjectScope.ts` already reasons. Labels and route behaviour unchanged.

**Tests.** Over the real `MetadataProvider` with a recording adapter: a package-less app's object route, its nav gates, and an out-of-bundle page route each ask no unscoped `/meta/object`, `/meta/view` or `/meta/page`; a CONTROL where the list is already loaded asks nothing more. Ablation back to the list read goes red. A before/after byte count on a production Console in the PR.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/app-shell` (`console/appObjectScope.ts`, `AppContent`'s page scope, `useNavMemberGates`). The three may split into separate PRs. Serialize after PR #29413 (#29235), whose by-name helper this reuses.

Dedupe: `is:issue package-less app registry`, `is:issue appObjectScope`, `is:issue useNavMemberGates views`, `is:issue AppContent page scope list` (only #29235, #28784, #29121, #28645 and epics/QA runs; #28784 is the packaged dashboard route). No card covers package-less app routes or out-of-bundle page routes.

Links back: #29235, PR #29413, #29121, #28645.
